name: fresh-default-backend-and-authenticated-UI
script: return Promise.all([window.csgclawDesktop.getRuntimeInfo(),fetch("/api/v1/bootstrap",{signal:AbortSignal.timeout(10000)}).then(r=>{if(r.status!==200)throw new Error("fresh desktop authorization failed");return r.status})]).then(([runtime,status])=>({runtime,bootstrap:status,viewport:[innerWidth,innerHeight],errors:document.body.innerText.includes("Unexpected Application Error")}))
